text: And to Allah, glory be to Him and exalted is He, belong the Most Beautiful Names, which indicate the perfection of His greatness, and all His names are beautiful, so ask Him by His names for what you desire, and abandon those who alter His names by addition, omission, or distortion, such as naming with them those who do not deserve them, like the polytheists naming their gods with them, or making for them a meaning not intended by Allah or His Messenger, for they will be recompensed for their evil deeds which they used to do in this world, of disbelief in Allah, and heresy in His names, and denial of His Messenger.
